Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1741323 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1741323. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
